description.value: The study investigated response inhibition and neural responses during a modified go/no-go task with sexual and neutral distractor backgrounds in males with problematic hypersexual behavior and healthy controls.

spans.text:
In this study, we examined the neural and psychological
underpinnings of inhibition in individuals with PHB.

value: We hypothesized that individuals with PHB would show reduced response inhibition compared to controls and, specifically, that inhibitory control might be more reduced during direct exposure to sex-related stimuli in individuals with PHB.

We also investigated the neural mechanisms underlying diminished inhibitory control among individuals with PHB, hypothesizing that they would show altered activation in the right IFG and preSMA compared to healthy controls.
